identity_check: Confirmed as Applied Intuition, Inc. (appliedintuition.com), the vehicle-software and physical-AI company founded in 2017 by Qasar Younis (CEO) and Peter Ludwig (CTO); its own funding posts for Series B through F, its About page and TechCrunch (Mar 2024) describe the same company and founders. Releases were datelined Mountain View, California through 2025 and Sunnyvale, California in 2026 (the About page now says headquartered in Sunnyvale). Not Intuition Robotics, Intuit, or any other 'Intuition'-named company. Category kept remote (PROJECT_CONTEXT §7, the 'shovels' role model): it sells simulation / validation tooling, a vehicle operating system and a self-driving stack to automakers, truck and off-road OEMs and defence customers. It does not sell plant-floor agents for procurement, maintenance or process stability, and nothing read mentions factories or WhatsApp. One overlap to watch: Dana (Jul 2026), an agentic platform that runs engineering workflows for teams building vehicles and autonomous machines (early users Isuzu and Komatsu), which sits near Utopian's design-intent tooling for hardware teams but targets autonomy development, not requirements traceability. Layer kept autonomy_tooling. Sector robotics_physical_ai by source: its 2026 boilerplate calls it 'a physical AI company providing tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy'; its named customers are still mostly automakers (18 of the top 20, per its releases).

open_items: Series A (Sep 2018, $11.5M led by Andreessen Horowitz) rests on one press page plus the company's later statements that a16z led the A; other participants and the exact day not found. Lux Capital and Floodgate are 'previous investors' at the Series B and may have been in the A or an earlier round; no seed round found.
Series F: the $600M combines a primary raise and a tender offer; the split is not disclosed. Total raised across Series A to F is $1,201.5M if the whole $600M is counted.

No 2026 round confirmed on any page read. Search summaries cite The Information (Oct 2026) reporting that Applied Intuition fielded offers at a $30B valuation; the article is paywalled and was not read, so it is not recorded.
Revenue not publicly reported; the Series E post claims only 'sustainable triple-digit percentage growth year-over-year, profitably'.
Headcount: About page gives '1,000+' engineers only; total headcount not found. The Series D post says the team 'more than doubled in a year' (2021).

Named customers taken from TechCrunch (Mar 2024: GM, Toyota, Volkswagen among '18 of the top 20 automakers'; Gatik, Motional, Kodiak; Army and DIU contract), the Dana release (Isuzu and Komatsu early access) and the company press list (U.S. Navy selection, Oct 2026). Partnerships with Honda, Nissan, Stellantis, Porsche, Audi, TRATON, OpenAI, HUMAIN and the U.S. Department of War selection were seen only as headlines or partner mentions and are not listed as customers.
Acquisitions made by Applied Intuition are not funding rounds and were not researched.
